lines.zh: 长袍扫过草地，脚步轻得像影子。
lines.en: My robe sweeps the grass; my steps fall like shadows.

lines.zh: 绕过这棵树，从另一边出现。
lines.en: I round this tree and reappear on the other side.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，只留一点冷气。
lines.en: Only a little chill is left where I have walked.

lines.zh: 四道身影散开，你追哪一个。
lines.en: Four silhouettes scatter at once; which one will you chase?

lines.zh: 袍角不沾泥，这是我最后的讲究。
lines.en: My hem stays clean; it is my last vanity.

lines.zh: 靠近时的风声，比箭先到。
lines.en: The wind of my approach arrives before any arrow.

lines.zh: 退回林间，把假象留在原地。
lines.en: I withdraw into the trees, leaving my doubles behind.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在你没看的地方。
lines.en: Every step lands where your eyes are not.

lines.zh: 慢些走，好让你数清我有几个。
lines.en: Walk slower, so you can count how many I am.

lines.zh: 影子在树影里，本来就分不清。
lines.en: In tree shade, shadows are hard to tell apart.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的视线走，从不走直。
lines.en: I walk around your gaze, never in a straight line.

lines.zh: 脚印是我留给你唯一的线索。
lines.en: Footprints are the only clue I leave for you.

lines.zh: 袖中三支箭，摸一摸还在。
lines.en: Three arrows in my sleeve; I touch them, still there.

lines.zh: 这张脸是借来的，看久了会淡。
lines.en: This face is borrowed; it fades if worn too long.

lines.zh: 远处的村子太吵，我不去。
lines.en: The far village is too loud; I stay away.

lines.zh: 没有观众时，幻象懒得维持。
lines.en: With no audience, the illusions are hardly worth keeping.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的影子，总有五个。
lines.en: I count my own shadows; there are always five.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在袋里叮当，我不急着数。
lines.en: Emeralds clink in my pouch; I do not hurry to count.

lines.zh: 图腾磨得发亮，我常用的东西。
lines.en: The totem is worn bright; I carry it often.

lines.zh: 林子的雾正好，适合藏身。
lines.en: The forest fog is just right for hiding.

lines.zh: 箭囊空了，就再折几根。
lines.en: When the quiver empties, I cut a few more.

lines.zh: 等天再暗一点，我才出门。
lines.en: I go out only when the sky darkens further.

lines.zh: 你看我，我却在看你的破绽。
lines.en: You watch me; I am watching your opening.

lines.zh: 眨眼一次，我就换到树的那边。
lines.en: Blink once, and I am on the far side of that tree.

lines.zh: 你的弓拉得不错，可惜瞄错了人。
lines.en: You draw well, but you aim at the wrong one.

lines.zh: 我看得见你手里的火把在抖。
lines.en: I can see the torch shaking in your hand.

lines.zh: 这一身铁甲，在雾里太显眼。
lines.en: That iron armor stands out badly in this fog.

lines.zh: 你数得清我们几个吗？
lines.en: Can you count how many of us there are?

lines.zh: 眼神别飘，我就在你正前方。
lines.en: Keep your eyes steady; I am right in front of you.

lines.zh: 你若转身，我保证还在原处。
lines.en: Turn around, and I promise I will still be here.

lines.zh: 每次对视，我都记下你的习惯。
lines.en: Every stare, I note one of your habits.

lines.zh: 先看手，再看脚，最后看眼睛。
lines.en: First the hands, then the feet, lastly the eyes.

lines.zh: 这一下打中了真的我。
lines.en: That blow landed on the real me.

lines.zh: 能碰到我，你运气不错。
lines.en: Touching me at all means your luck is good.

lines.zh: 袍子破了，我记你一笔。
lines.en: The robe is torn; I mark that against you.

lines.zh: 疼是真的，你也不是假象。
lines.en: The pain is real, so you are no illusion either.

lines.zh: 我的影子替我喊了一声。
lines.en: One of my doubles cried out in my place.

lines.zh: 退两步，重新算一遍距离。
lines.en: Two steps back; I recalculate the distance.

lines.zh: 你比上一个猎物快一点。
lines.en: You are slightly quicker than the last prey.

lines.zh: 手在抖，我按住袖口。
lines.en: My hand shakes; I press it against my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这下我得认真了。
lines.en: Now I must take this seriously.

lines.zh: 别以为伤到我，就看穿了我。
lines.en: Wounding me does not mean you have seen through me.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜？我把它射在树上。
lines.en: A carrot? I will pin it to a tree.

lines.zh: 食物诱不来我，我只对破绽感兴趣。
lines.en: Food cannot lure me; only openings interest me.

lines.zh: 你举着面包的样子很可笑。
lines.en: You look ridiculous holding up that bread.

lines.zh: 我吃的是耐心，不是麦子。
lines.en: I feed on patience, not on wheat.

lines.zh: 把手放下，那玩意儿对我无用。
lines.en: Lower your hand; that thing is useless to me.

lines.zh: 诱惑是猎物的手段，不是猎人的。
lines.en: Luring is the prey's trick, not the hunter's.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只差一个时机。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only lack the right moment.

lines.zh: 留着自己吃吧，路还长。
lines.en: Keep it for yourself; the road is long.

lines.zh: 你的饵太亮，一看就是陷阱。
lines.en: Your bait is too bright; clearly a trap.

lines.zh: 比起面包，我更想要你的箭。
lines.en: More than bread, I want your arrows.

lines.zh: 撞上我？你扑到的是空气。
lines.en: Bump into me? You have grabbed at air.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我讨厌被摸到。
lines.en: Do not press so close; I hate being touched.

lines.zh: 袍子被你踩了，这可要记账。
lines.en: You stepped on my robe; that goes on the tally.

lines.zh: 退开三步，我的幻影怕挤。
lines.en: Three steps back; my doubles dislike crowds.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的力道，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the force of your charge.

lines.zh: 让一让，我的影子要过去。
lines.en: Make way; my shadow needs to pass.

lines.zh: 碰到的若是假的，你更该怕。
lines.en: If that one was false, you should fear more.

lines.zh: 站远些，我出手不会打招呼。
lines.en: Stand back; I do not announce my strikes.

lines.zh: 你推我一下，四道影子都晃。
lines.en: One shove from you and all four doubles sway.

lines.zh: 这个距离，箭已经不用瞄准。
lines.en: At this range, the arrow needs no aiming.

lines.zh: 分身已经够多，我不需要同伴。
lines.en: I have enough doubles; I need no companion.

lines.zh: 同族相见，只比谁的幻术更真。
lines.en: Kin meeting kin only compare whose illusion is truer.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我把自己分成四个就行。
lines.en: Breeding? I simply split myself into four.

lines.zh: 爱这东西，我早就不练了。
lines.en: Love is a trick I stopped practicing long ago.

lines.zh: 若真有同族，也只交谈几句。
lines.en: If kin truly exist, we exchange only a few words.

lines.zh: 袍子底下没有心跳，只有戏法。
lines.en: No heartbeat under this robe, only sleight of hand.

lines.zh: 孤独是幻术师最忠实的学徒。
lines.en: Loneliness is an illusionist's most loyal apprentice.

lines.zh: 两个人的秘密，不如一个人的。
lines.en: A secret shared by two is weaker than my own.

lines.zh: 我不留后代，只留传闻。
lines.en: I leave no offspring, only rumors.

lines.zh: 等你倒下，会记得我这张脸。
lines.en: When you fall, you will remember this face.

lines.zh: 箭我捡，绿宝石我也捡。
lines.en: I pick up arrows, and emeralds as well.

lines.zh: 这根箭断了一半，还能用。
lines.en: This arrow is half broken, but still usable.

lines.zh: 图腾落地，我弯腰都省了。
lines.en: The totem fell; I need not even bend for it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，归先看见的人。
lines.en: Whatever falls belongs to the one who sees it first.

lines.zh: 我把箭塞回箭囊，动作很轻。
lines.en: I slide the arrow back into the quiver softly.

lines.zh: 这枚绿宝石，换你一条命。
lines.en: One emerald here could buy your life.

lines.zh: 捡东西时别偷袭，我背后有眼。
lines.en: Do not stab me while I gather; I have eyes behind.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，正好补我的缺。
lines.en: Your dropped arrows fill my quiver nicely.

lines.zh: 口袋沉一点，心里就稳一点。
lines.en: A heavier pocket steadies my mind.

lines.zh: 捡完了，我们再谈下一步。
lines.en: Now that I have gathered, we discuss the next step.

lines.zh: 你踩断树枝的那一声，够了。
lines.en: That snapped twig was all the sign I needed.

lines.zh: 锁定：那个拿弓的，先解决。
lines.en: Locked: the one with the bow goes down first.

lines.zh: 影子们已经围好，别回头。
lines.en: My doubles are in place; do not look behind.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了节拍，雾把它放大。
lines.en: Your breathing lost its rhythm; the fog magnifies it.

lines.zh: 从这一刻起，你走哪我跟哪。
lines.en: From now on, wherever you go, I follow.

lines.zh: 猎物入雾，戏就开场了。
lines.en: The prey enters the fog, and the play begins.

lines.zh: 我看见你缩在盾后面。
lines.en: I see you crouched behind that shield.

lines.zh: 四个我，一个你，算术很简单。
lines.en: Four of me, one of you; the arithmetic is simple.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来我会更认真。
lines.en: Do not run; running only makes me serious.

lines.zh: 记住这张脸，它陪你到最后。
lines.en: Remember this face; it stays with you to the end.

lines.zh: 先射腿，让你慢下来再说。
lines.en: A shot at the legs will slow you first.

lines.zh: 你转身找同伴，可这里只有我。
lines.en: You turn for allies, but only I am here.

lines.zh: 贪心的人总会离村子太远。
lines.en: The greedy always wander too far from the village.

lines.zh: 你踏进这片林子的那步，就定了。
lines.en: The step that brought you here sealed it.

lines.zh: 雾里那点绿，是我给你的标记。
lines.en: That green in the fog is my mark on you.

lines.zh: 你数错了我的分身，这就够了。
lines.en: You miscounted my doubles; that is enough.

lines.zh: 箭在弦上，只等你的破绽。
lines.en: Arrow on string, waiting for one opening.

lines.zh: 向左一步，我的箭就在左边。
lines.en: Step left, and my arrow waits on the left.

lines.zh: 别站定，站定正中我的准星。
lines.en: Do not stand still; standing still fills my sights.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就放箭。
lines.en: I count to three, then the arrow flies.

lines.zh: 我的分身在同一秒拉弦。
lines.en: My doubles draw their strings the same second.

lines.zh: 你举盾的角度，我看得一清二楚。
lines.en: I see exactly the angle of your shield.

lines.zh: 绿光落在你脸上，那是我在瞄准。
lines.en: Green light on your face means I am aiming.

lines.zh: 再退一步，就出我的射程边缘。
lines.en: One more step back and you leave my range.

lines.zh: 我在等你抬手的那一瞬间。
lines.en: I am waiting for the instant you raise your arm.

lines.zh: 影子们的箭，只有一支是真的。
lines.en: Of all the doubles' arrows, only one is real.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，手指就不会抖。
lines.en: Slow the breath, and the fingers stop shaking.

lines.zh: 你听见弓弦响时，已经晚了。
lines.en: Hear the string release, and it is too late.

lines.zh: 这箭上抹的不是毒，是黑暗。
lines.en: This arrow carries no poison, only darkness.

lines.zh: 背对我也没关系，我照样射中。
lines.en: Turn your back if you like; I still hit.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，树干挡不住箭。
lines.en: That trunk will not stop an arrow.

lines.zh: 我站到你背后，你没听见脚步。
lines.en: I stand behind you; you heard no steps.

lines.zh: 拉弦的声音先到，箭后到。
lines.en: The draw sounds first, the arrow second.

lines.zh: 你数着四个我，其实有五个。
lines.en: You count four of me; there are five.

lines.zh: 你的盾冲着我，箭从上面来。
lines.en: Your shield faces me, so the arrow comes from above.

lines.zh: 我放慢呼吸，好让你的手抖起来。
lines.en: I slow my breath so that your hands begin to shake.

lines.zh: 箭尖擦过，你的护甲响了一声。
lines.en: The tip grazes you; your armor rings once.

lines.zh: 这一下不是砍，是提醒。
lines.en: This strike is not a cut, but a reminder.

lines.zh: 近距离我也能射，别以为安全。
lines.en: I shoot at close range too; do not feel safe.

lines.zh: 你扑过来，正好撞上我的准星。
lines.en: You lunge, and land right in my sights.

lines.zh: 袍子一甩，我退到你的死角。
lines.en: A flick of my robe and I am at your blind side.

lines.zh: 箭尾还在颤，你已退了半步。
lines.en: The fletching still quivers; you already stepped back.

lines.zh: 盾挡得住箭，挡不住第二支。
lines.en: Your shield stops one arrow, not the second.

lines.zh: 我出手时不出声，这是规矩。
lines.en: I strike in silence; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 你踉跄的那一下，我记下了。
lines.en: I noted the moment your footing slipped.

lines.zh: 这一箭换你一次喘息，够了。
lines.en: One arrow for one gasp of yours is enough.

lines.zh: 分身也补了一箭，你分不清。
lines.en: A double adds another shot; you cannot tell which.

lines.zh: 贴得越近，你越躲不开。
lines.en: The closer you come, the less you can dodge.

lines.zh: 我打完就退，从不留在原地。
lines.en: I retreat after striking; I never linger.

lines.zh: 疼吗？那就记住这片林子。
lines.en: Does it hurt? Then remember this forest.

lines.zh: 我用弓臂撞你的手腕。
lines.en: I strike your wrist with my bow arm.

lines.zh: 这一箭贴着你耳侧过去，是警告。
lines.en: That arrow passed your ear as a warning.

lines.zh: 你追上来那一步，踩进了我的影子。
lines.en: The step you took to close in entered my shadow.

lines.zh: 我退开时留下一片雾，你追错了。
lines.en: I left fog behind; you chased the wrong one.

lines.zh: 近身之后，我的箭更短更狠。
lines.en: Up close my arrows are shorter and crueler.

lines.zh: 身上多了两支箭，还站得住吗？
lines.en: Two arrows in you; can you still stand?

lines.zh: 雾散开，我站在林子正中。
lines.en: The fog parts; I stand at the forest center.

lines.zh: 我来时没有脚步，只有影子。
lines.en: I arrived with no footsteps, only shadows.

lines.zh: 五道身影同时睁眼，其中一个是我。
lines.en: Five figures open their eyes at once; one is me.

lines.zh: 这片林子太静，我来加点戏。
lines.en: This forest is too quiet; I add some theater.

lines.zh: 袍子落地，戏法就成了。
lines.en: The robe settles, and the trick is complete.

lines.zh: 先看看四周，找个人当观众。
lines.en: First I look around for someone to be my audience.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，弓已上弦。
lines.en: I step out of the mist, bow already strung.

lines.zh: 谁在这附近？我闻到铁味。
lines.en: Who is nearby? I smell iron in the air.

lines.zh: 幻术师来了，别信你看见的。
lines.en: The illusionist is here; trust nothing you see.

lines.zh: 影子先到，我随后。
lines.en: My shadows arrive first; I follow behind.

lines.zh: 这张脸是新借的，还合身。
lines.en: This face is newly borrowed, and fits well.

lines.zh: 我来守这片林子，谁也别想直穿。
lines.en: I guard this forest; none cross it straight through.

lines.zh: 袍角着火，我拍了两下才灭。
lines.en: My hem catches fire; two slaps put it out.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖一沉，戏法差点散了。
lines.en: My knees buckle on landing; the trick nearly unravels.

lines.zh: 水灌进袍子，幻术在水里不好使。
lines.en: Water fills my robe; illusions work poorly in water.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡着，分身全被震没了。
lines.en: Ears ringing, all my doubles shaken away.

lines.zh: 你的箭钉在我肩上，还带着准头。
lines.en: Your arrow sticks in my shoulder, well aimed.

lines.zh: 药水味太冲，我的幻象被冲淡了。
lines.en: The potion reeks; it thins out my illusions.

lines.zh: 饿得连分身都撑不住，只剩我一个。
lines.en: Too starved to hold my doubles; only I remain.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，影子们替我挡了半下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my shadows take half of it.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，连影子都追不上我。
lines.en: Falling, even my shadows cannot keep up.
